headline: Down 11 Late, Caleb Williams Answered. Chicago's No. 18 Is Built for December
title: Caleb Williams: Thanksgiving Winner With 3 Seconds Left
subheadline: Williams threw for 345 yards and two touchdowns, the last a 6-yard strike to Rome Odunze with three seconds left, as Chicago rallied past Detroit 39-35.
description: Caleb Williams threw for 345 yards and hit Rome Odunze for the winning score with 3 seconds left as the Bears beat Detroit 39-35. Why his No. 18 matters now.
searchIntent: Bears fans who watched the Thanksgiving comeback want the key numbers and the right No. 18 jersey.
body: Caleb Williams led the Chicago Bears back from an 11-point fourth-quarter deficit on Thanksgiving, Thursday, Nov. 26, and finished it with a 6-yard touchdown pass to Rome Odunze with three seconds left in a 39-35 win over the Detroit Lions at Ford Field. He completed 30 of 44 passes for 345 yards and two touchdowns without an interception.
It was the first lead of the day for Chicago, and it came after Williams kept the final drive alive with a designed run on fourth-and-1.
## Why fans are buying in

The stakes made this one more than a holiday highlight. The Bears and Lions came in tied for first in the NFC North, and the win moved Chicago to 9-2 with a sixth straight victory and sole possession of the division lead. The Bears also became just the third team to win on Thanksgiving after trailing by 11 or more points in the fourth quarter.

There is a homecoming angle, too. Williams was the No. 1 overall pick when the 2024 draft was held in Detroit, and he threw a last-second winner back in that same city. In our analysis, a franchise quarterback winning a division showdown on national television is exactly the kind of night that turns casual Bears fans into jersey buyers.

His merchandise already has a published track record. Williams ranked eighth on the NFLPA's Top 50 player sales list for March 1, 2025 to Feb. 28, 2026, up from 13th on the previous year's list. That list counts all licensed player merchandise, led by jerseys.
## The look
Williams wears No. 18. The banner above shows the navy home jersey, the white road version and the orange alternate, the boldest of the three for fans who already own the navy.
## Why this jersey will last
A 9-2 record, a division lead and a quarterback still early in his career give this jersey a long runway. Chicago hosts Jacksonville on Dec. 6.

title: DeVonta Smith: Career-High 200 Yards in Thanksgiving Rally
subheadline: Smith caught 11 passes for 200 yards and two long touchdowns as Philadelphia erased a 21-point deficit and beat Dallas 39-38 on a 59-yard field goal.
description: DeVonta Smith caught 11 passes for a career-high 200 yards and two touchdowns as the Eagles erased a 21-point deficit to beat Dallas 39-38. Why his No. 6 fits.
searchIntent: Eagles fans who saw the Thanksgiving comeback in Dallas want Smith's numbers and the right No. 6 jersey.
body: DeVonta Smith had the best receiving day of his career on Thanksgiving, Thursday, Nov. 26, catching 11 passes for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Philadelphia's 39-38 win over the Dallas Cowboys at AT&T Stadium. His scores covered 50 and 45 yards.
Jake Elliott won it with a 59-yard field goal with two seconds left, capping a comeback from 21 points down in the third quarter, the largest lead ever lost on Thanksgiving.
## Why fans are buying in

Smith was the steady piece in a game full of chaos. Philadelphia started Joe Milton, making his third career start, and Smith gave him a target who could turn any throw into a big play. Both long touchdowns came in the second and third quarters and kept the Eagles within reach before the fourth-quarter rally, and his 23-yard catch in the fourth quarter set up Milton's 15-yard touchdown run.

The win was a second straight for the defending NFC East champions, who came in at 3-7 and now sit at 4-7. In our analysis, a career day in Dallas, on the league's biggest holiday stage, is the kind of moment Eagles fans remember for years.
Smith already has a place on a published list. He ranked 29th on the NFLPA's Top 50 player sales list for March 1, 2024 to Feb. 28, 2025, which counts all licensed player merchandise, led by jerseys.
## The look
Smith wears No. 6. The banner above shows the midnight green home jersey, the white road version and the kelly green alternate, a throwback color from the franchise's past.
## Why this jersey will last
A homegrown receiver with a career-best game and a long run in one city gives this jersey staying power. Philadelphia visits Arizona on Dec. 6.

headline: Jahmyr Gibbs Ran for 205 on Thanksgiving, and Detroit's No. 0 Keeps Gaining Ground
title: Jahmyr Gibbs: 205 Rushing Yards and 3 TDs on Thanksgiving
subheadline: Gibbs ran 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns, including a 70-yard sprint, and added 47 receiving yards against Chicago at Ford Field.
description: Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 205 yards and three touchdowns, including a 70-yard score, for 252 scrimmage yards on Thanksgiving. Why Detroit's No. 0 keeps rising.
searchIntent: Lions fans who watched Gibbs run wild on Thanksgiving want his numbers and the right No. 0 jersey.
body: Jahmyr Gibbs gave Detroit its signature performance of Thanksgiving, Thursday, Nov. 26, running 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns against the Chicago Bears at Ford Field. His third score was a 70-yard run midway through the fourth quarter, and he added five catches for 47 yards.
That made 252 yards from scrimmage, matching the total he put up against New England earlier this month. Chicago won 39-35 on a late touchdown, but no one on the field produced more than Gibbs.
## Why fans are buying in

Big holiday games are when the whole country watches the Lions, and Gibbs used the stage to show why he is one of the league's most dangerous backs. He averaged nearly 10 yards a carry and scored from the 1 twice before breaking the long one.

The bigger picture is strong, too. Detroit came in on a six-game winning streak and is 8-3, still in the thick of the NFC North race. In our analysis, a player who can match a 252-yard game twice in one month is turning into the face of the franchise's offense, and that is what drives interest in a jersey.

His merchandise has a published record. Gibbs ranked 16th on the NFLPA's Top 50 player sales list for March 1, 2025 to Feb. 28, 2026, up from 20th the year before. The list counts all licensed player merchandise, led by jerseys.
## The look
Gibbs wears No. 0. The banner above shows the white road jersey and the silver 2026 Rivalries Collection design, a newer look that stands apart from the classic Honolulu blue.
## Why this jersey will last
A young back in his prime, on a contender, with two of the biggest games of the season in the same month, gives this jersey a long shelf life. Detroit visits Atlanta on Dec. 6.
